sources.title: dikiyplayerpig/dpp-gpt-V2.2-base-260m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 260M-parameter model trained entirely from scratch on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060) by one person, in Russian, English and French. It continues text, and — because part of the pre-training data is already in a chat format — it can also count, spell words, count letters and translate when asked in that format.
